scope: Development-only higher-order metric derivation on fresh-v3. Confirmation still requires a second disjoint authority.
hypothesis: The remaining first-order rank error, especially MLP5 for is/was, is caused by suffix curvature and saturation. A fixed quarter-dose carrier intervention on A1 will preserve screening efficiency while predicting full-dose A2 effects more accurately.
primary_score: Mean absolute normalized donor recovery from adding 0.25 times the exact donor-minus-base MLP output at all paired A1 carrier positions, divided by 0.25.

predictions.pred_a_capability_position_coverage_fini: The same A1 development capability rows recur; 26 forwards, 394 evaluations, and 270 unique low-dose records.
predictions.pred_b_finite_dose_improves_both_rank_co: Spearman against frozen full-dose A2 causal effects exceeds first-order baselines 0.95 has/had and 0.65 is/was for both tasks.
predictions.pred_c_finite_dose_is_strong_enough_for_: Both correlations exceed 0.80 and MLP4 is top-three by score for both tasks.
predictions.pred_d_fixed_dose_zero_fit_development_s: Dose is fixed before execution; no fitted scalar, backward pass, or model update.

decision: screen graduates the fixed-dose formula to a second disjoint A1-to-A2 test; null means direct causal screening remains preferable to further metric complexity; invalid on capability, position, coverage, matching, finiteness, dose, or accounting failure
